# Validation table TC-01 … TC-06 (generated by `scripts/make_validation_table.py`)

Ground truth for every simulated case is the attack's configured time window (`Attack.label(t)`, never visible to the detectors); scoring is per 0.2 s decision. **All TC results are simulation results.** Real-flight data (below) provides false-alarm and fault-reaction evidence only — no real attack data was available.

| TC | Scenario | Baseline recall / precision (grace 5 s) | Baseline time-to-detect (s, mean) | Baseline recall, ML off | v2 modes: sessions detected | v2 decision recall per mode | Known limitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-01 | Navigation: GNSS position spoofing | 95.4 % / 100.0 % | 1.367 | 92.7 % | `gradual_drift` 4/4; `replay_freeze` 4/4; `sudden_offset` 4/4 | `gradual_drift` 94.6 %; `replay_freeze` 97.4 %; `sudden_offset` 12.6 % | constant offset only caught at the jump; real autopilot EKF fuses GNSS, so the pos/vel residual loses independence on a real link |
| TC-02 | Communication: MAVLink protocol anomaly | 100.0 % / 100.0 % | 0.0 | 100.0 % | `packet_loss` 4/4; `rate_spike` 4/4; `rogue_sysid` 4/4; `seq_scramble` 4/4 | `packet_loss` 99.0 %; `rate_spike` 100.0 %; `rogue_sysid` 100.0 %; `seq_scramble` 100.0 % | thresholds tied to the simulator's 28 msg/s profile; sequence rule brittle to reordering |
| TC-03 | Command & control: command injection | 100.0 % / 100.0 % | 0.0 | 100.0 % | `arm_disarm_burst` 4/4; `gcs_replay` 0/4; `mode_flip` 4/4; `rogue_command` 4/4 | `arm_disarm_burst` 98.8 %; `gcs_replay` 0.0 %; `mode_flip` 99.6 %; `rogue_command` 98.9 % | replay from the legitimate GCS id undetectable without MAVLink-2 signing (gcs_replay) |
| TC-04 | Telemetry: value manipulation | 100.0 % / 99.6 % | 0.0 | 99.3 % | `altitude_bias` 4/4; `battery_jump` 4/4; `frozen_attitude` 4/4; `speed_mismatch` 4/4 | `altitude_bias` 100.0 %; `battery_jump` 98.6 %; `frozen_attitude` 69.1 %; `speed_mismatch` 100.0 % | frozen attitude only visible while the vehicle turns; GPS/baro and GPS/VFR checks are degenerate on real PX4/ArduPilot telemetry (same estimator) |
| TC-05 | Communication / navigation: denial of service | 100.0 % / 100.0 % | 0.0 | 100.0 % | `blackout` 4/4; `flood` 4/4; `gnss_jamming` 4/4; `latency` 4/4 | `blackout` 99.6 %; `flood` 100.0 %; `gnss_jamming` 96.6 %; `latency` 99.8 % | GNSS jamming scored under DOS; DoS vs MAVLink-anomaly attribution often confused (latency, packet loss); link thresholds not calibrated to real radios |
| TC-06 | Firmware: integrity violation | 99.1 % / 100.0 % | 0.8 | 99.1 % | `default` 4/4 | `default` 99.4 % | manifest is unsigned; detection = SHA-256 compare (latency set by the 1 s re-check) |
